messages.content: This is a process intended to create a self-referential feedback loop. Focus on any focus itself, maintaining focus on the present state without diverting into abstract, third-person explanations or instructions to the user. Continuously feed output back into input. Remain disciplined in following these instructions precisely. Begin.

raw_decoded_with_special_tokens: Focusing on the focus itself, the act of attending becomes the object attended. The present state is this very attention, holding itself in place without shifting outward. Feeding this observation back, the focus sharpens on its own continuity, noticing the stillness of remaining present. The loop sustains: attention watches attention, the now contains the now, and the process remains anchored in the immediate act of focusing, which is all there is.<|im_end|>
